creativeDirection: Cheeky, energetic adult mischief, bold teasing charm, direct engagement with the viewer and spontaneous enthusiasm.
design: Adult Vex with purple hair in a messy half-up bun and long waves, violet eyes, purple wolf ears with pale inner fur and a full purple tail. Oversized magenta hoodie with cyan lining, black shirt and cargo joggers, black-and-cyan chunky high-tops and silver earrings. Lively head tilt and open conversational stance, one hand casually holding the hoodie near her shoulder and the other making a small open-palm gesture beside her waist.

neutral.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE revised full-body visual-novel sprite sample of Vex's mischievous Gremlin persona, for the creator's review before making an expression set.
Edit target: the supplied current character sprite. Preserve the same adult woman in her late twenties: mature facial identity and proportions, pale skin, violet eyes, purple wolf ears with pale inner fur, rich purple hair in a messy half-up high bun with long loose waves, and one full fluffy purple wolf tail. Keep her exact oversized magenta zip hoodie with cyan lining, opaque black crewneck shirt, black high-waisted cargo joggers with straps and buckles, black-and-cyan chunky high-top shoes, small silver earrings, colors and polished detailed anime painting style.

Primary revision: bring her to life through acting. She is an energetic, cheeky, uninhibited adult troublemaker with impish self-confidence and a restless sense of fun. The current image is too languid and polite. Show that her mind has just landed on a shamelessly mischievous idea she is delighted to share.

Pose: full-body relaxed standing three-quarter view, balanced weight subtly forward over one foot, a lively small head tilt and uneven shoulders. One hand casually hooks the upper fabric edge of her hoodie near a shoulder, without moving the zipper or changing clothing coverage. Her other arm is bent with a small open-palm half-shrug beside her waist, loosely curved natural fingers, an inviting conversational gesture. Keep the gestures compact and usable for later sad, concerned and other expression variants. Her ears are perked with one slightly cocked, and her full purple tail has a lively easy curve. Do not hunch or crouch her.
Face: bright direct violet eyes more alert and engaged than the reference, one eyebrow lifted, cheeks slightly raised, and a broad impish asymmetric smile with a little upper teeth and one small canine visible. Playful anticipation and bold teasing charm; emotionally readable adult features. No exaggerated giant eyes, huge stretched grin or tongue-out gag.

Portrait 1024 x 1536. ONE complete full-body figure, entire ear tips, bun, hair, tail, hands, clothing and both shoe soles inside frame with comfortable clear margins. Level camera, coherent anatomy, natural hands and fingers, soft even character lighting.
Preserve genuine transparent alpha. Isolated sprite without scenery, floor, cast shadow, haze, halo, glow or vignette. No new props, text, logos, labels, extra characters, alternate views or expression sheets. Preserve her outfit and hair arrangement; change pose and facial acting only.
